# Custom geometry extraction

Source: https://github.com/genspark-ai/genoffice at `953595e2f1635140e2a6c1f86c2fa12b0cca77b8`.

Only `packages/pptx-engine/src/custgeom.ts` and the three-field `CustomGeometry` interface from its `types.ts` are included, under Apache-2.0. No PPTX ZIP/Node engine is imported. Local required-value guards and repository formatting adapt the source to strict TypeScript. Original/current hashes are recorded by the sibling DOCX engine provenance manifest.
